title: Evidence v0.1
description: An evidence packet backing a response/fulfillment (charter v0.1 §7). Graded on the estate metadata-standards evidence_grade ladder E1..E5 — CONSUMED, not reinvented. E3+ evidence MUST attach null_hypothesis_ids (falsification / counter-explanation), matching metadata-standards teeth (E3+ ⇒ null_hypothesis_ids). response_ref MUST point to a LaborResponse.

artifact_refs.description: Ledger seqs / credential ids / artifact ids evidencing the claim (charter §7.3 evidence examples).

null_hypothesis_ids.description: Required when evidence_grade >= E3 (metadata-standards). Falsification / counter-explanations.
